Title: Duplicate quiz question appears in Easy and Medium
Reproduction: Run focused contract check or compare normalized question text by species and difficulty in ai_quiz_questions.json.
Expected: No question is repeated across difficulty levels for one species.
Actual: Four-striped Ground Squirrel repeats ‘What is the scientific name…?’ in Easy and Medium.

Title: Battle regression suite disagrees with tuned opening shield
Reproduction: Run backend pytest; inspect the two failures in test_battle_rules.py.
Expected: All 198 regression tests pass against the agreed opening-shield rule.
Actual: 196 pass; two assertions expect 8-point shielding while production now applies 10, producing HP 25/83 instead of 23/81.

Title: AI threat assessment omits child Energy and available abilities
Reproduction: Inspect wildlife_ai.py state_action_key and _score_action; vary child Energy/abilities while other state stays fixed.
Expected: Decision considers child Energy, available abilities, costs/effects and future threat.
Actual: Threat estimate uses child Basic Attack and AI HP; child Energy/ability threat is not represented.

Title: AI evaluation is not representative across HP/Energy states
Reproduction: Inspect train_wildlife_ai.py make_match/evaluate and run evaluation.
Expected: Evaluation explicitly covers low/full HP, low/high Energy, habitat advantage states, unlock states, cards, initiative and opponent profiles.
Actual: Matches vary cards/habitats/unlocks/initiative/opponent profile but start at full HP and 5 Energy; required coverage is not asserted.

Title: AI outlier review is incomplete
Reproduction: Run policy evaluation and inspect retained reports.
Expected: Win rate, length, action/ability use and persistent card/habitat outliers are reviewed with findings retained.
Actual: Metrics are printed, but no completed review of persistent card/habitat or ability-concentration outliers is retained.

Title: No evidenced release review of consistently unbalanced AI behaviour
Reproduction: Inspect repository reports and release evidence after representative AI evaluation.
Expected: Persistent imbalance triggers a documented policy or battle-balance review before release.
Actual: No completed review artefact is present; current documented random-opponent AI win rate is 84.4% under standard-start evaluation.

Title: Frontend dependency audit reports critical/high vulnerabilities
Reproduction: From rimbaquest run npm audit --json after npm ci.
Expected: No unresolved critical or high dependency vulnerabilities at release gate.
Actual: 48 total: 1 critical, 31 high and 16 moderate; critical path includes shell-quote through React Native tooling.
